Mason City Farmers Market - Winter Market

Description
Shop local at the Mason City Farmers Market Winter Market on Saturday, November 7th, from 12 PM to 3 PM at Southbridge Mall! Browse a variety of local vendors offering unique goods, handmade items, seasonal products, and more. Support local businesses and find something special while enjoying the indoor market. For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/events/1475793521067901/1475793524401234/. 

Southbridge Mall

100 South Federal Avenue, Mason City, IA 50401
